cards.name: Alakazam
cards.description: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

cards.name: Nidoking
cards.description: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

cards.name: Nidoqueen
cards.description: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

cards.name: Ninetales
cards.description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

cards.name: Pidgeot
cards.description: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

cards.name: Poliwrath
cards.description: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.description: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

cards.name: Zapdos
cards.description: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

cards.name: Beedrill
cards.description: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

cards.name: Dragonair
cards.description: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

cards.name: Mr. Mime
cards.description: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

cards.name: Pidgeotto
cards.description: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

cards.name: Pinsir
cards.description: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

cards.name: Chansey
cards.description: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

cards.name: Venomoth
cards.description: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

cards.name: Dewgong
cards.description: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

cards.name: Dodrio
cards.description: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

cards.name: Exeggutor
cards.description: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

cards.name: Farfetch'd
cards.description: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

cards.name: Haunter
cards.description: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

cards.name: Ivysaur
cards.description: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

cards.name: Jynx
cards.description: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

cards.name: Kadabra
cards.description: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

cards.name: Kakuna
cards.description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

cards.name: Machoke
cards.description: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

cards.name: Clefable
cards.description: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

cards.name: Nidorina
cards.description: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.description: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

cards.name: Poliwhirl
cards.description: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

cards.name: Seaking
cards.description: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

cards.name: Seel
cards.description: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

cards.name: Doduo
cards.description: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

cards.name: Exeggcute
cards.description: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

cards.name: Goldeen
cards.description: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

cards.name: Nidoran♀
cards.description: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidoran♂
cards.description: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

cards.name: Pidgey
cards.description: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

cards.name: Poliwag
cards.description: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

cards.name: Starmie
cards.description: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

cards.name: Venonat
cards.description: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

cards.name: Vulpix
cards.description: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.
